key_insight: The paper proposes View-PNDF, a parameter-efficient way to make multi-view chest X-ray report generation more consistent by selectively fine-tuning neurons that are specific to each view.
clinical_relevance: By reducing inconsistencies across radiographic views, the approach may improve the reliability of AI-generated radiology reports for clinical workflow support.
method: Detect neurons that respond to specific X-ray views.
Verify and quantify view-specific neuron presence.
Fine-tune only the detected neurons, then use an LLM to merge view-specific reports into a full report.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on two medical radiology report generation benchmarks and showed improved view-specific report quality, with both standard NLG metrics and GPT-4o-based assessment used for evaluation.
watch_item: Because the method relies on view-specific neuron detection and LLM-based report consolidation, performance may depend on accurate view labeling and robust integration across views.
paper_title: Seeing Through Multiple Views: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Selective Neurons for Consistent Radiology Report Generation
